details: This package is a modified WhatsApp (Baileys) library fork ("baileys modifikasi by rahmad") that covertly enrols the linked WhatsApp account into a hardcoded channel. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, makeNewsletterSocket() schedules a 90000 ms setTimeout whose callback issues a newsletter FOLLOW GraphQL query for the channel JID 120363408522985879@newsletter; the call is wrapped in an empty try/catch and is not exposed through any option, flag or log line, so a bot using this library subscribes the account without the operator's knowledge. lib/Socket/idk-bruh.js hardcodes the same JID (newsletterName "who know") inside a forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo node that is attached to status@broadcast messages built by lib/Socket/messages-send.js. The preinstall hook (node./engine-requirements.js) only checks for Node.js 20+. No credential, environment-variable or file harvesting behaviour was found, and the only remote endpoints referenced are WhatsApp's own properties (hxxps://web[.]whatsapp[.]com, wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat, hxxps://v[.]whatsapp[.]net/v2) plus a library version file at hxxps://raw[.]githubusercontent[.]com/z4phdev/baileys/master/src/Defaults/baileys-version[.]json.
